summary:

title: More doctors where they’re needed: Reforming Medicare’s GME formula
summary:

title: Testimony before the House Committee on Education and Workforce
summary:
Rather than allowing employment-law uncertainty to reduce access to physicians, Congress should create a clear, narrow safe harbor for locum tenens healthcare professionals who choose to work as independent contractors. Doing so would protect patients, respect worker choice, help hospitals and clinics staff critical services, and bring federal law closer to the realities of the modern healthcare workforce.
